notes.title: Development Recap: New Aircraft, Graphics, Campaign Improvements, and More
notes.content:
It has been a little over three months since the Steam release of Warplanes: Air Corp, and it's a good time to sum up all of the changes, improvements, and new features added in the updates.

Flight model improvements and further flight setup
Thanks to player feedback, we've introduced multiple flight model tweaks to make vehicle control pleasantly smooth. Flight Setup gives you a wide range of options to customize control sensitivity and in a nutshell – physics to your preferences.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44611406/79c24dab94ad3c1f9957321d054d689f93aa3fc1.png

Takeoffs, landings and reloading
Introduced as a direct response to the community's most frequent suggestions.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44611406/a512a3f4b243a7cb967e596a7662fe995b798ebf.png

Two new helicopters and VTOL mode in MF-35

 Hi-24 Hind – generously outfitted with armaments and thick armor.
 ND 530C – lightly armed helicopter for reconnaissance that also unlocks brand new mission type.
 MF-35 – enriched with a VTOL mode.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44611406/f0e7df08efcf5e1f0234a2d7b6e8103876f862e8.png

Campaign improvements
Changes also affected the campaign, we improved the balance, and mission objectives are now clearer. There is a new mission type – the evacuation of a soldier. Further development of the single-player mode is planned.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44611406/37a3f97e102a9aa99a66efc6f88185584a94c51d.png

Graphics improvements
More varied times of day. A lot of subtle changes that give an improvement in the visuals quality – we added naturally lit clouds, and the horizon looks more realistic. We've expanded the lighting system and shaders, making reflections more vivid.
We've added new assets to add variety to the environment – apart from airports, several new structures and buildings have appeared. There were also some minor enhancements like posters in the base.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44611406/25404481e9ab55fcdc5b1480bf21fecf9adcdb00.png

Further development
More major updates are planned that will expand Warplanes: Air Corp with new content and improvements. Stay tuned, and remember to visit our Discord.

notes.title: Version 1.5 changelog
notes.content:
New mission type: Soldier Evacuation intended for ND 530C helicopter.
 Improved weather system offering much more diverse environments.
 Checkboxes in the “Controls” section for inverting analog sticks (throttle and yoke Y axis).
 Improved readability of the cockpit map and unit markers on the HUD.
 Posters in the hangar (it's good to stand up from the monitor once in a while and look around).
 Bug fixes and other improvements.
